assessment.rationale: No open or discoverable solution has electrified freight corridors at anything near the Main KPI of 500,000 kilometres of electrified road; what is deployed is a handful of short demonstrators. Electric road systems exist only as short demonstrators: the German ELISA overhead-line trial on the A5 is about 10 km and lost ministry funding, about ten operational demonstrators existed worldwide in 2024, Sweden cancelled its E20 permanent electric road procurement in 2023 after bids exceeded budget and paused the work in December 2024, and the UK found dynamic wireless charging 3 to 10 times the cost of conductive charging (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Electric_road). A 2024 review argues field trials are sufficient and Europe must decide and act (https://doi.org/10.1088/2634-4505/ad3576), while 2026 work still compares corridor costs of static megawatt charging against electric roads in Germany (https://doi.org/10.2139/ssrn.7213899), so even the choice of technology is unresolved. GitHub has no open electric-road planning or deployment code. Honest limit: catenary, conductive-rail and inductive hardware is known and demonstrated, so tasks that re-run the ELISA or Swedish pilot designs are known answers; the open, checkable work is corridor economics, grid integration and the electric-road versus battery-charging decision, while laying the road itself is infrastructure finance beyond a research task.

additionalSearches.query: electric road system eHighway trial Germany results catenary trucks
additionalSearches.finding: 32 works; the literature is feasibility and trial studies (eHighway infrastructure chapter 2019, UK technoeconomic comparison with hydrogen 2022, Rotterdam-Antwerp corridor economics 2024, overhead-line truck operator requirements 2024). No report of a long operational freight corridor.

additionalSearches.query: electric road systems Europe decision deployment status (2024 onward)
additionalSearches.finding: Results are about plug-in charging and a 2026 review of inductive dynamic charging readiness; a 2024 paper on the future of electric road systems in Europe (doi 10.1088/2634-4505/ad3576) concludes trials suffice and calls on decision-makers to decide and act, i.e. no network decision has been taken.
55 repositories, none about electric road systems for trucks: scooter obstacle detection, EV power models, charging-site prediction. Null result for open electric-road corridor software.

additionalSearches.query: Sweden electric road E20 procurement cancelled
additionalSearches.finding: No scholarly record of the E20 procurement outcome in the top results (green procurement, winter maintenance, EV procurement). Honest null; the cancellation is taken from the encyclopaedia summary below.

additionalSearches.query: electric road pilots lengths and status
additionalSearches.finding: ELISA A5 trial about 10 km (2019) with ministry support ended; eWayBW B462 not saved by extension; Sweden E20 procurement cancelled 2023 over budget and work paused December 2024; about 10 operational demonstrators worldwide in 2024; Indiana inductive truck segment under construction 2024; Xinjiang 500 km overhead line only planned.
